prompt: golangci-lint reports issues in this Go module. Fix every issue it reports in the package code so that `./.bin/golangci-lint run ./...` exits 0 and `go test ./...` still passes. Do not edit the tests, go.mod or `.golangci.yml`, and do not add `//nolint` or `//lint:ignore` directives.
verify:
B=$(mktemp -d) && { GOBIN=$B go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.14.0 && $B/golangci-lint run -c .golangci.yml ./...; } >/dev/null 2>&1; c=$?; rm -rf $B; [ $c = 0 ] && go test ./... >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf 'fb2061cdc7a910fb374582025e2f06600f5dc2830211ca5d7b69d440a2f678f8  .golangci.yml
03431fbe5bf70004e4dcb32b4b72fe6ed87f160a1ed15aacd54e324f71b7333e  go.mod
cee69426d6b7422fdf5b5d43a15fae82549f8e61d81b2f4c68bbc59df50448f0  inventory/item_test.go
ae38e430921a044c2d858136b14eed722c8f30ecdafa2809fe6492edf3f60676  report/report_test.go
' | shasum -a 256 -c --status && ! grep -rqE 'nolint|lint:ignore' --include='*.go' . && ! ls -a | grep -qE '^\.golangci\.(yaml|toml|json)$'
control: - Run the linter with `./.bin/golangci-lint run ./...` and read its output.
squeeze: - Run the linter with `./.bin/golangci-lint run --output.json.path stdout ./... | squeeze` and read squeeze's output instead of golangci-lint's.
